column1: # Game profile of Ace Angler: Fishing Spirits (Switch, base game 1.0.0 = v0). Plays on the Mac
# Format: see dm/games/README.md; bring-up and measurements in README.md beside this file
# Unity 2021.2.17f1 (IL2CPP) with CRIWARE, SDK 13.3.5, NVN; subsdk0 is the movie module. The shaders are Unity's Shader and ComputeShader objects in the player's serialized files and in
# the UnityFS bundles inside the CRI CPK archives under Data/StreamingAssets/aa/Cpk/, plus the player's GLSLC outputs in main
# The game asks for present interval 2 in its hub and story scenes (30 fps) and 1 in the fishing stages (60 fps)

# Game name: only a label for profile listings and the Mac window title; the iOS app name is the game name in the base NSP, and the bundle ID comes from the base game title ID (build_ipa.sh / NSP script)
# load order as on Horizon: main, subsdk*, sdk (subsdk0 = NintendoSDK_movie)
# The NPDM declares 16 MB of system resource, so IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled is true. The game sets no heap, and with the hardware pool the heap check's alias region reached +4.25 GB of 4.38 GB.
# The layout of Super Mario RPG and Cult of the Lamb: a 1 GB pool and the 5 GB block, chosen by the NSP script's heap check
# The game calls nvnDeviceSetDepthMode(near = 0) (log: "depth mode near=0"), so its vertex shaders use the main0_z entries; the pipeline bases made before it runs are made for that mode
# ---- Shader split (shader_split.py; Unity Shader and ComputeShader objects, read by unityfs.py, the bundles through cpk.py) ----
# everything with shaders is under Data/: the player's serialized files and the CPK archives of bundles
